duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at Chongqing University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6.Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency. 8.Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here.

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese Citizen 2.In Good Health 3.Under the age of 45 4.The applicants must meet the minimum English language requirement of IELTS 6.0 or equivalent level
